application.assembly_requirement: x86_64, x87 and SSE2; all128 bits of XMM0..15. Raw syscall ABI and signal-return restore required; ordinary C calls retain SysV caller-saved semantics.
application.flag_scope: -march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -mno-avx constrains this compile of C/assembly, not prebuilt static libc objects or IFUNC dispatch. Static ELF/no INTERP and no YMM/ZMM in native_vector_probe prove neither absence of AVX throughout the ELF nor absence of additional runtime state.

libc.payload_linkage: Exact selected payload is statically linked; its C runtime calls include pthreads, signal setup, syscall wrappers, printf/puts and exit. The static libc archive identity/implementation-selection closure was not retained in report2, so neither exact static-libc vector requirements nor no-AVX closure is declared.
libc.staged_identity_scope: These exact retained dynamic artifacts support the selected application environment, but the static vector payload does not prove their used ISA paths or final supported applications. Do not infer their version/ISA from GCC version or file hash alone.
libc.ifunc_limit: Potential feature-dispatched libc implementations are a requirements gap, not proof AVX was executed in this application.
